Dear [Miss Redgrave](/person/2411),
I like your plea for the Hedgerow very much indeed and hope to put it in whenever there is room.

Was that old man a real character, if he was, should there not be a note to say so.

It would so much enhance the interest[^1]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: This article cannot be identified in MP. CMY\'s correspondent may possibly be the Elizabeth Redgrave whose The Word and the Work, or, The Harmony of Scripture with Geological Discoveries (London: Mozley 1860) was praised in MP (January 1860), 111.

It was described as \'a series of conversations between a clergyman and a mechanic, intended to popularize Hugh Miller\'s views of the Periods of Creation, and to show how they may be reconciled with the Scriptural narrative.\'
